findings.detail: Fresh lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed. All 36 evidence items preserve admitted input; grouped marginal, relationship, operation-record and locator mappings/hashes agree. Registered sources, retained analytic input/script bindings and auxiliary artifacts verify. Freeze and decision remained unchanged.

Static code implements the specified independent uniform factors, independent age/sex/Bernoulli class and centered affine mixture. It creates 3000 rows with six task columns, unique IDs and integer ages 35-74. The task supplies no exact demographic quotas. The HbA1c extra class term correctly makes the total class shift kH rather than double-counting betaG*kG.

Independent 2x2 inversion derives joint percent-scale coefficients BMI=0.005872569756097562 and glucose=0.197450432 from two separate native-IFCC Jansen projections under assumed residual correlation 0.25. NGSP level/SD/slope rules are correct. Independent source OLS gives native-IFCC BMI 0.13 and FPG 2.2899999999999996; equality is imposed, not validation.

Independent direct mixture covariance identities reproduce all three contexts' moments and positive variance decompositions. Target within-class glucose variance is 0.52 and HbA1c residual variance 0.6826240740379911. Primitive-corner extrema reproduce positive target bounds: BMI [18.7646170928,31.2353829072], glucose [3.2784114378,10.3215885622], HbA1c [4.0417352370,9.6029250393]. The selected Jansen FPG upper bound is below 7.

All factors and finite mixture branches are bounded, so actual affine outputs have finite absolute moments of every positive order. Positive age/sex variances and successive nonzero U/V/E loadings give full population rank; independent Cholesky checks passed. Population target-law projections E1=0.015760314991354718, E2=0.3849415907588688, E3=0.005 reproduce retained consequences. E3 is explicitly an assumed age effect, not learned evidence.

All four admitted relationships are accounted for with correct source/context IDs, reachable numeric artifacts, uncertainty/selection/measurement/overlap assumptions: two Jansen constraints, Bao analytic check, and MIND context_only. Independent Bao Pearson is 0.6824284695170836 versus 0.619, raw discrepancy +0.06342846951708359, retained without refitting or tolerance. All 99 independent checks passed.

MIND Spearman has no supplied selected rank/imputation law and is truthfully not calculated or assigned to parameters. No Pearson substitution occurs. Every quantitative source comparison on target tables is unavailable, with null operators and hash-bound unsupported semantic declarations. Analytic source scenarios are not replay or exact source reconstruction.

Residual dependence, nuisance effects, latent class prevalence/shifts, source memberships, uniform supports and source-to-target assay/population transfer are explicit assumptions. The mixture class is not observed diabetes prevalence or an exclusion. Bao context scales are declared approximations to median/IQR evidence, not exact quantile conversion. Source-estimate, structural and transport uncertainty remain unquantified; no favorable-fit criterion was applied.

No generator/author script import or execution, participant rows, numerical quadrature, target clinical reference, unassigned candidate or old experiment was used. Support corners are algebraic extrema only. Runtime table validity and sample rank remain for isolated execution. Review did not close science, consume trials or deliver seeds.
